data.prompt: Close view of a small Antarctic tent on flat white snow in summer daylight. Its entire triangular canvas door is shut, both edges joined by clearly visible tied cords. A gloved adult waits beside the closed door.

data.sub: 阿蒙森《南極》・離開小帳時

data.prompt: Close view of gloved adult hands raising a brass sextant toward the low Antarctic sun. Its open fan-shaped frame has a curved measuring arc and a short pivoting arm. Flat white snow stretches beneath the bright summer sky.

Inside a small Antarctic tent, gloved adult hands push a small blank envelope halfway into the open mouth of a soft cloth bag. The bag and envelope fill the foreground; canvas walls and white polar ice catch summer daylight.
